support_definition.method: ALL voxelized accepted-submap points with nearest distance <=2.5m to ALL current voxel points transformed by ORIGINAL causal IMU/CV guess
support_definition.reverse_initial_guess: inverse ORIGINAL prediction; NOT inverse forward result
support_definition.current_population: ALL range-filtered and voxelized current points
support_definition.target_population: immutable prefit support; conditional overlap, NOT fraction of full submap
support_definition.trim_rounding: ceil(0.70 * count of finite nearest-neighbor distances <=0.50m)
support_definition.empty_or_insufficient_support: FAIL; blank/null metrics, never zero as quality
support_definition.allpoint_fitness: record both cropped target and full local-submap untruncated PCL scores; neither is sole admission

causal_policy.gyro_bias_semantics: provisional value, NOT estimated;0.05rad/s assumed norm sensitivity scenario, NOT guaranteed physical bound
causal_policy.rotation_deskew: full T_imu_lidar^-1 * deltaT_IMU_end_point * T_imu_lidar; includes fixed lever arm
causal_policy.translation: first TWO scans unknown; thereafter CV ONLY from last two accepted IMU-origin poses; never current scan registration result
causal_policy.TX1_missing_imu: omit only points earlier than first observed IMU; retain raw/used/omitted counts; no backfill
causal_policy.prediction_rows: NOT LiDAR observations; never enter submap, CV history or fitting

trajectory_gate.estimation_interval: [first+5s, first+8s); ALL target scans in interval must be accepted real observations

preintegration.method: piecewise midpoint SO3 integration, fixed calibrated extrinsic, no gravity/bias prior in rank test
preintegration.noise_units: discrete per-sample standard deviations (m/s^2 and rad/s), conservative pose uncertainty dominates; not continuous noise densities
preintegration.profile_condition_definition: singular-value condition of velocity-eliminated residual-whitened profile, fixed scales: gravity tangent 9.809*radians(5), ba 0.50; normal equation condition is its square
preintegration.robust_observability: sigma_min lower bound max(0,sigma_min(profile)-Frobenius bound on profile perturbation from 3-sigma rotation uncertainty); require positive lower bound and robust condition <=10000
preintegration.covariance_policy: diagnostic profile with motion uncertainty and worst-correlation inflation; state acceptance additionally requires full coupled bg/v/ba/g covariance, lever-arm Jacobian and propagation to boot; no priors supplying rank

covariance.order: position map, rotation right/body, velocity map, bg IMU, ba IMU, gravity IKFoM S2 tangent
covariance.rank_deficient_policy: NO_STATE_ACCEPTANCE; no pseudoinverse covariance passed as finite certainty

gates_origin: V2 engineering contract frozen before ANY real V2 registration. IMU mismatch<=5deg is a heuristic guard, NOT statistically calibrated. All inherited state gates unchanged.
